signal_cable.termination: Centre conductor to CIN; braid to driven SHLD. Insulate the exposed braid and never connect it to ground.
signal_cable.soldering: Leave at most 2 mm unshielded centre conductor at each end. Support the jacket before working on the 0.15 mm conductor; qualify the soldering process on spare foils.

plate_wires.construction: Two independent 34 AWG stranded insulated copper leads per plate, insulation diameter at most 0.55 mm
connections: JS pin 3 to the first plate bond
JS pin 4 to the separate second plate bond
plate_wires.bond_process: Use MG 8331D only in the supplied ground-bond envelopes after the cover has cured. Measure continuity through the plate; do not join the two wires before their separate plate bonds.

routing.finger_exit: Lead the six cables from the supplied side/proximal tabs toward the outer side of the finger; leave the leading nail edge and fork notch free.
routing.strain_relief: Anchor each coax jacket to its terminal stiffener with a small qualified flexible adhesive bead beyond the solder lands. Keep the 4 mm nail flex bend unbonded. Ground leads require their own slack loops; they must not brace the moving plate.
routing.case_relief: Pass each cell's coax and two ground leads through its numbered case port and secure the insulated jackets with a 2.5 mm cable tie through the adjacent slots. Do not crush the coax.
routing.installation: Mount the two bank cases within the 150 mm cable reach. The case tabs are a bench/wrist mounting interface; the unknown installed YAM drive still needs a measured bracket and full jaw-motion clearance check.
routing.qualification: Measure cable length, bend radius, no-contact motion signal, pull resistance and full jaw travel before installed operation. CAD clearances alone do not qualify a moving cable.

limits: Cable capacitance is a manufacturer specification; the full shield load and shield stability must be measured on the assembled board.
This cable is not assigned a robot bend-cycle life by this design.
The two reference grounds do not replace either independently monitored pressure-plate bond.
